listing_info.listing_name: NEW 6BR Brookside Cottage Trout Stream #LAKE WINNI
listing_info.description:
This cozy 6 BR Historic Homestead -sleeps 14 - on 2 acres with over 500 feet of waterfront along Wingate Trout Stream flowing into Lake Winnipesaukee.

While the deed dates to 1815, the 1846 Brookside Cottage was once a boarding house - full of timeless character—thoughtfully maintained, comfortably appointed, with new linens & beds.

Stones throw to LAKE WINNI, Wolfboro, Brewster Beach and Melvin Village. In winter, ski resorts like Waterville Valley, Gunstock, and King Pine all close by.

The space
Sprawling 6 BR farmhouse with outdoor firepit on 500 ft Wingate Brook flowing into Lake Winnepesaukee .
Front side of the Cozy Farmhouse on main road is close proximity to restaurants & shopping & boat rental in Wolfboro and quaint Melvin Village.
Bedroom 1: One queen bed with cozy accents (Sleeps 2)
Bedroom 2: Two queen beds, farmhouse-style furnishings (Sleeps 4)

Rear side of historic homestead on waterfront trout stream leading to Lake Winnipesaukee.
Bedroom 3: A private master suite featuring a king bed, en suite bathroom, and warm, farmhouse accents. (Sleeps 2).
Bedroom 4: Another queen bedroom. (Sleeps 2)
Bedroom 5: A queen bed with antique charm. (Sleeps 2)
Bedroom 6: One serene larger bedroom with a king bed and stunning premier rear property views overlooking the tranquil Wingate Trout Stream. (Sleeps 2)

Unwind at the fire pit overlooking 500ft waterfront trout stream leading to Lake Winnepesaukee - throw in a fishing pole and watch sunset - ideal for nights and toasty marshmallows.

Guest access
6-bedroom property, with two entrances, connecting the home in the middle, two dedicated parking lots, and full access to the rear of the home. Guests also enjoy full access to a cozy outdoor fire pit and trout stream.

Other things to note
This historical 6 Bedroom Brookside Cottage is your typical New England sprawling 1815 homestead that has been added on through the centuries to connect to the Barn. Although the Barn is not included with your stay, The historical farm house is comprised of two separate two-story homes each with their own kitchen and living/dining spaces for families to have separate seclusion when preferred and gather together to enjoy and plan your meals in various dining spaces indoors and out! The front 2 Bedroom home and rear 4 Bedroom two story home are connected in the middle to provide one FUN multi family vacation.

We provide an introductory supply of toilet paper and paper towel along with all new luxurious linens and towels.
Please be sure to bring anything else to make your stay enjoyable. We have fully furnished kitchens so if you like to cook please don’t forget all of your favorite condiments, butter, cream coffee, tea ,sugar, salt and pepper, favorite meat and veggies for the grill, extra toilet paper, garbage bags , paper towels, shampoo, conditioner, body and laundry soap. Make yourself at home!

Please note only SINGLE PLY TOILET PAPER is allowed in the septic system.
Please do not flush anything other than single ply toilet paper - no paper towels nor wipes nor sanitary napkins nor tampons in the toilets please 🙏

listing_info.listing_name: 3BR dog friendly house w/beach access & pickleball
listing_info.description:
The Beech Cottage

The space
Come visit the quaint town of Tuftonboro, NH located in the Lake Region of NH, this family-friendly house offers a peaceful retreat for those looking to escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Immerse yourself in the extraordinary beauty of the countryside living by the lake. Enjoy the convenience of two beaches within walking distance, tennis and pickleball courts, and excellent fishing opportunities stocked by the state with trout. Take advantage of the nearby attractions such as Lake Winnipesaukee, Albee Beach, Castle in the Clouds, Wright Museum, and the charming town of Wolfeboro, all just a short drive away. Check out the local shops, farmstands and dining at local restaurants. For those visiting Brewster Academy or Huggins Hospital, this property offers a convenient location. Golf enthusiasts will appreciate the proximity to Wolfeboro, Ossipee, and Moultonboro golf courses, while snow skiing and mountain activities are easily accessible at Gunstock, King Pine, and other resorts within a short drive.

Relax in the comfort of this well-equipped house with amenities like a crib, washer/dryer, internet, and a fully stocked kitchen. An added feature... a deck with a secure gate for your furry friends and little ones, you can relax and unwind knowing everyone is safe.

With a variety of outdoor activities, several hiking trails, parks, and museums nearby, as well as exciting events like NH Motor Speedway, Laconia Bike Week, Rotary Ice Fishing Derby, and concerts in Gilford, this home is sure to please everyone in your family/group. Whether you're seeking adventure, relaxation, or family fun, this Tuftonboro retreat has something for everyone.

Things to Know

This property is managed by First Chair Operating Company LLC
New Hampshire Meals and Rentals Tax Operator's License Number: 106893

Guest access
You'll enter through the left-side door of the home via a smart lock deadbolt. Enter your 10-digit code and wait for the flashing green light, then click and physically turn the deadbolt to unlock. To lock, enter the code again, listen for the click, then physically turn the deadbolt the opposite way. Please verify the door is fully locked after securing it.

A secondary lockbox is located on the side-door handle as a backup. Check your confirmation email for access codes.

Other things to note
If the home has a hot tub, you're welcome to use it during daylight hours - use is restricted between 10pm and 8am.

This is a quiet neighborhood with beautiful nearby water access. Note that local beaches are not dog-friendly during peak summer hours, and fires are not permitted at the beach.
